messages:
maya: Morning folks — quick triage check-in for today (standup style).

maya: Current queue: 42 open tickets (P1:1, P2:6, P3:35). P1 is #4521 (payments failing for subset of EU customers).

ops-bot: Incident status: no platform-wide outages. Recent deploys: r-infer-2026-03-16-4 succeeded in us-west-2.

maya: Blockers: need dev time for P1 — the payments flow traces suggest a bad retry loop in the gateway integration. @jonathan can you pick this up if you're available?

jonathan: On it, I can take the P1. Quick note — I started a draft PR and attached logs to the ticket.

linda: Ticket volume looks normal for the week spike. For the payment ticket, adding the macro `billing_refund_v2` is helpful but it needs the new wording we agreed on (shorter instructions + link to payments runbook). I pushed an edit suggestion in the macro repo.

maya: Thanks @linda — can you paste the exact macro text here? I'll approve and publish.

linda: Sure: ```Macro: billing_refund_v3
Step 1: Confirm customer id+tx id.
Step 2: Run `payments:refund --id <tx>` (do not re-run refund if status=processing).
Step 3: If refund fails, escalate to payments-oncall @support-rotations.
Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/payments-refund```

maya: Looks good. I removed the confusing bit about manual ledger entries. Approving now and will publish by EOD.

jonathan: For the P1 root cause, initial hypothesis is a race in our async retry code around the gateway 429 handling. I have a reproducer and will post patch in the ticket.

maya: Other notes: two recurring P3s about token scoping — added a one-line doc to the KB and created macro `token_scope_guidance` for agents.

support-rotations: @oncall Today: jonathan (primary), linda (backup). Escalation channel: #payments-oncall.

maya: Anything else? If not, I'll close this thread and update the triage board. :thumbsup:

linda: All good from me.

jonathan: I'll update when I have the PR, ETA ~2 hours.

maya: Thanks — marking P1 in progress and assigning. Closing thread after PR link.
